scope: current-byte revalidation of judge argv, permission policy, verdict extraction and same-attempt environment reuse

findings.evidence: renderForJudge still omits --allowedTools entirely when the manifest allowedTools contains only Write/Edit/Bash; current AgentInvocationOptionsSpec asserts argv == [--model, m].

The old argv omission survives, but 2cb47c2 added role-fixed JUDGE permission mode dontAsk and --strict-mcp-config to the actually launched argv, with tests asserting no acceptEdits/bypassPermissions. A live successful Write/Edit/Bash judge remains unproven; the previous risk statement must now include this new hard permission fence and must not imply direct write capability.
JudgeVerdictExtractor still strips the first fence and takes the first balanced JSON object. The current JudgeVerdictExtractorSpec documents first-object behavior and passes.
FreshJudgeEnvironments still returns the same current environment when the attempt SHA matches; a new attempt SHA disposes/replaces it.

notes: No live provider mutation test was used; write exploitability is not claimed.
